model_choice: Binary variables x_i (select site) and y_j (site covered). Cardinality constraint sum x_i = k. Implication constraints y_j <= sum_i A_ij x_i. N~160 -> 320 vars, dense QUBO fits backend.

prep.notes: Extracted latest monthly total population for each village. Converted TWD97 TM2 coordinates to WGS84 lat/lon. Joined tables using district and village name. Note: The raw table stacks multiple years/months; summing all rows yields ~5.0M, but the correct city total for the latest period is ~2.4M, which matches our extraction.
